verses.en: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.
verses.pt: Sim, certamente Deus é bom para Israel, para os limpos de coração.
verses.en_web: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, God is good to Israel, even to such as are clean in heart.

verses.en: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.pt: Eu porém, quase que meus pés se desviaram; quase nada faltou para meus passos escorregarem.
verses.en_web: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
verses.en_bbe: But as for me, my feet had almost gone from under me; I was near to slipping;

verses.en: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.pt: Porque eu tinha inveja dos arrogantes, quando via a prosperidade dos perversos.
verses.en_web: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: Because of my envy of the men of pride, when I saw the well-being of the wrongdoers.

verses.en: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
verses.pt: Porque não há problemas para eles até sua morte, e o vigor deles continua firme.
verses.en_web: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.
verses.en_bbe: For they have no pain; their bodies are fat and strong.

verses.en: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
verses.pt: Não são tão oprimidos como o homem comum, nem são afligidos como os outros homens;
verses.en_web: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
verses.en_bbe: They are not in trouble as others are; they have no part in the unhappy fate of men.

verses.en: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
verses.pt: Por isso eles são rodeados de arrogância como um colar; estão cobertos de violência como se fosse um vestido.
verses.en_web: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason pride is round them like a chain; they are clothed with violent behaviour as with a robe.

verses.en: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
verses.pt: Seus olhos incham de gordura; são excessivos os desejos do coração deles.
verses.en_web: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
verses.en_bbe: Their eyes are bursting with fat; they have more than their heart's desire.

verses.en: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
verses.pt: Eles são escarnecedores e oprimem falando mal e falando arrogantemente.
verses.en_web: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.
verses.en_bbe: Their thoughts are deep with evil designs; their talk from their seats of power is of cruel acts.

verses.en: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
verses.pt: Elevam suas bocas ao céu, e suas línguas andam na terra.
verses.en_web: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Their mouth goes up to heaven; their tongues go walking through the earth.

verses.en: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
verses.pt: Por isso seu povo volta para cá, e as águas lhes são espremidas por completo.
verses.en_web: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason they are full of bread; and water is ever flowing for them.

verses.en: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
verses.pt: E dizem: Como Deus saberia? Será que o Altíssimo tem conhecimento disto?
verses.en_web: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”
verses.en_bbe: And they say, How will the Lord see this? is there knowledge in the Most High?

verses.en: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
verses.pt: Eis que estes são perversos, sempre estão confortáveis e aumentam seus bens.
verses.en_web: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, such are the sinners; they do well at all times, and their wealth is increased.

verses.en: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
verses.pt: Cheguei a pensar: Certamente purifiquei meu coração e lavei minhas mãos na inocência inutilmente,
verses.en_web: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
verses.en_bbe: As for me, I have made my heart clean to no purpose, washing my hands in righteousness;

verses.en: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
verses.pt: Porque sou afligido o dia todo, e castigado toda manhã.
verses.en_web: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
verses.en_bbe: For I have been troubled all the day; every morning have I undergone punishment.

verses.en: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
verses.pt: Se eu tivesse dito isto, eu falaria dessa maneira; eis que teria decepcionado a geração de teus filhos.
verses.en_web: If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
verses.en_bbe: If I would make clear what it is like, I would say, You are false to the generation of your children.

verses.en: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
verses.pt: Quando tentei entender, isto me pareceu trabalhoso.
verses.en_web: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me;
verses.en_bbe: When my thoughts were turned to see the reason of this, it was a weariness in my eyes;

verses.en: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
verses.pt: Até que entrei nos santuários de Deus, e entendi o fim de tais pessoas.
verses.en_web: Until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.
verses.en_bbe: Till I went into God's holy place, and saw the end of the evil-doers.

verses.en: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
verses.pt: Certamente tu os fazes escorregarem, e os lança em assolações.
verses.en_web: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
verses.en_bbe: You put their feet where there was danger of slipping, so that they go down into destruction.

verses.en: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
verses.pt: Como eles foram assolados tão repentinamente! Eles se acabaram, e se consumiram de medo.
verses.en_web: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
verses.en_bbe: How suddenly are they wasted! fears are the cause of their destruction.

verses.en: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
verses.pt: Como o sonho depois de acordar, ó Senhor, quando tu acordares desprezarás a aparência deles;
verses.en_web: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
verses.en_bbe: As a dream when one is awake, they are ended; they are like an image gone out of mind when sleep is over.

verses.en: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
verses.pt: Porque meu coração tem se amargurado, e meus rins têm sentido dolorosas picadas.
verses.en_web: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.
verses.en_bbe: My heart was made bitter, and I was pained by the bite of grief:

verses.en: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
verses.pt: Então me comportei como tolo, e nada sabia; tornei-me como um animal para contigo.
verses.en_web: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
verses.en_bbe: As for me, I was foolish, and without knowledge; I was like a beast before you.

verses.en: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
verses.pt: Porém agora estarei continuamente contigo; tu tens segurado minha mão direita.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
verses.en_bbe: But still I am ever with you; you have taken me by my right hand.

verses.en: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verses.pt: Tu me guiarás com teu conselho, e depois me receberás em glória.
verses.en_web: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verses.en_bbe: Your wisdom will be my guide, and later you will put me in a place of honour.

verses.en: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
verses.pt: A quem tenho no céu além de ti? E quando estou contigo, nada há na terra que eu deseje.
verses.en_web: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
verses.en_bbe: Whom have I in heaven but you? and having you I have no desire for anything on earth.

verses.en: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
verses.pt: Minha carne e meu coração desfalecem; porém Deus será a rocha do meu coração e minha porção para sempre.
verses.en_web: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
verses.en_bbe: My flesh and my heart are wasting away: but God is the Rock of my heart and my eternal heritage.

verses.en: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
verses.pt: Porque eis que os que ficaram longe de ti perecerão; tu destróis todo infiel a ti.
verses.en_web: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
verses.en_bbe: For those who are far away from you will come to destruction: you will put an end to all those who have not kept faith with you.

verses.en: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
verses.pt: Mas quanto a mim, bom me é me aproximar de Deus; ponho minha confiança no Senhor DEUS, para que eu conte todas as tuas obras. Instrução de Asafe:
verses.en_web: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord Yahweh my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.
verses.en_bbe: But it is good for me to come near to God: I have put my faith in the Lord God, so that I may make clear all his works.
